email.subject: Quick note about Velvet Co's website
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I was looking at salon sites in Harbor Falls and checked out Velvet Co's. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there's no way to book online, and no click-to-call button on mobile, so anyone searching on their phone has to manually dial or dig for a contact form. Most people just move to the next salon instead.

I also noticed your hours aren't listed and there are no reviews shown, which makes new visitors hesitate.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you what I'd change first - no pressure either way.

Alex
